text:
jake_cs: Quick ask - Greenhaven Labs wants a Brazil (sa-east1) peering + temporary allowlist for a week-long pilot. Need header pin + soft QPS bump. Can we triage?

mina_ops: Hosted API or Dedicated? Also need CIDRs and exact window.

jake_cs: Hosted for now. Contact: rafael@greenhaven.io. Window: 2026-06-10 00:00 -> 2026-06-16 23:59 UTC. Sustained 100 QPS, peak demos to 500 for short bursts. CIDRs: 44.55.0.0/16 and 2001:db8:1234::/48. Header pin: X-GH-ORG: greenhaven.

omar_net: Edge can handle v4+v6 allowlist and header check. We'll prepare a peering request and brief maintenance for the config push. Recommend auto-revoke after 2026-06-17.

lina_pm: Renewal check in July - capture performance feedback and attach a short survey. This pilot could be a sales motion.

mina_ops: Risk note - 500 burst QPS may impact token burn. Proposal: feature-flagged route + canary rollout (2% -> 20% -> 100%) and a billing cap of $1.5k for the window. Add prefix caching.

omar_net: Edge snippet for proxy team:
```
allowlist_ips: ["44.55.0.0/16","2001:db8:1234::/48"]
header_whitelist: ["X-GH-ORG"]
region_route: "sa-east1"
rate_limit_override: { "qps": 500, "window": "2026-06-10/2026-06-16" }
auto_revoke: true
```

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-2467: "Greenhaven Labs sa-east1 peering + temp QPS". Owners: mina_ops, omar_net.

mina_ops: I'll draft the customer acceptance email and include data handling consent + billing cap. Can omar confirm revert is a single toggle?

omar_net: Yes, revert is a single switch. I'll add an emergency throttle command to the runbook: `rb throttle cs-2467 --qps 50`.

lina_pm: I'll create an eval checklist (p95 latency, token-cost delta, routing correctness, failed header hits, customer NPS). We'll run daily checks during the window and attach results to CS-2467.

jake_cs: Assigning owners: jake (customer comms), mina (ops + billing cap), omar (edge + peering), lina (renewal + feedback). I'll update CS-2467 with timeline.

mina_ops: Timeline: today validate CIDRs and consent; T+1 create canary route 2%; T+2 ramp to 20% if green; 2026-06-10 start window full traffic if canary passes.

ojops: ACK - calendar reminders set for auto-revoke on 2026-06-17.

\jake_cs: Closing loop - once canary green, we'll ask Rafael for manual go/no-go. Thanks everyone.
